infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Loc8 Guard shares your on-duty position with your team and the control room over the offline mesh. On-shift only.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Loc8 Guard keeps you reachable to your team during an active shift.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Loc8 Guard uses Bluetooth to reach your team phone-to-phone when there's no network.
